title: ASENA: Self-evolving Agents for Embodied Navigation
primary_reason_zh: 冻结coding/improver/controller权重，依据执行轨迹和simulator反馈修改notes及可执行skills，跨pass保留并在写入关闭时评估，满足Harness方法。可选VLN单独训练不构成该演化循环权重共演化；重复任务成功率不等于独立留出泛化。
changes: v2主要扩展humanoid manipulation：SAM2+depth、可选GraspGenX、IK/motion planning、head OAK stereo与YAM grippers，区分SONIC body控制和gripper控制。
旧版通用skills重组为Navigation/Manipulation/Composition/Execution checks；独立验证和operator approval仍保留，G1修订时motion disabled。
四组workspace演化仍是同task/scene/instruction/pose复现十pass；未增加新任务独立holdout。
HM-EQA/MT-HM3D evolution pools与monitor aggregate继续回传improver，冻结workspace后测试不自动变成独立留出。手工quality/efficient配置也非单因素控制。
v2新增定性fetch-carry-handoff细节与未来new-task/repeated-trial局限，不能写真实部署可靠性已系统验证。
表2删Qwen-RobotNav-8B行、补引用，其他实验表核心数值不变；硬件表新增camera/gripper，runtime说明从表注移入正文。
量化用早期step8400 checkpoint，runtime agreement是输出一致性而非导航成功，ONNX大小不是峰值内存。

numeric_checks.finding: Claude SR 61→72 R2R、50→61 RxR各+11pp；Astra87→88 R2R而RxR93→86，不能称所有backend准确率均改善。Tool calls四组下降59.2/62.5/46.9/51.0%，与表数算式一致。
每集100task/10scenes；RxR四非有限NE/SPL仍作SR失败，NE/SPL分母96，须保留不同分母。
HM-EQA最高81.2为pass17 high effort；MT-HM3D最高66.5为pass4 low，非同checkpoint全优；pass17 low64.9。Table4手工quality MT67.1，不能称evolved比所有手工点都更准。
pools398/1183，16workers每pass各sample50；未采样monitor仍向improver提供聚合反馈，不标held-out=yes。
component total2806→877约3.20x，实际BF16端到端2735ms是另一口径；step8400旧checkpoint，非benchmark rollout时延。
abstract仍称R2R/RxR SR均SOTA，但表1已有Qwen-RobotNav-4B RxR71.3高于ASENA70.2；只报告具体数值和比较条件，不复述笼统SOTA。
72→98及65→89来源仍为abstract的recurring-task campaign；未读取图二进制或原始logs，不能称对这些曲线逐点复算，且不可混为fresh-workspace表3起点。

evidence.quote: It writes and revises task logic and motion plans using execution feedback, while physical execution interfaces remain fixed.
a separate fixed-weight improver uses execution traces
Model and controller weights remain fixed.
repeatedly presenting the same tasks, scenes, instructions, and initial poses.
Questions not sampled by the workers are used for monitoring, and their aggregate results are also provided to the improver.
The G1 demonstrations provide qualitative evidence of capability composition rather than a systematic measure of reliability across objects, layouts, and users.
Physical motion requires validation and operator approval, including motion requested by revised programs.

coverage: v2完整Method/Evaluation/Discussion/Appendix A文字、所有HTML表与图注已读；对照v1对应方法/监控/结论和全部表变化。未逐字审bibliography、原始轨迹或二进制图。
